responsibility: Supplies the NetBSD ELF subtarget configuration for VAX by combining generic VAX ELF support with NetBSD driver and preprocessor conventions. It installs NetBSD OS builtins and specs, wires VAX PIC-related CC1 specs into the NetBSD driver flow, selects the ELF link spec and entry point naming used on NetBSD, and sets the default backend feature mask appropriate for gas-based VAX NetBSD targets.
